title: The Fifteen Minutes That Change Everything
author: Steve Dalton

beats.scene: MEDIUM: two monochrome halftone cutout figures seated facing each other on the cream stage, a flat burnt orange disc behind them

beats.change_only: a burnt orange cross stroke strikes through the space between the two figures

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome hourglass standing alone on the cream stage, a burnt orange arc drawn around its waist

beats.change_only: most of the orange sand drops into the lower chamber at once

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome cutout figure holding a large blank placard up toward another figure, a heavy burnt orange cross stroke over the placard

beats.change_only: the struck placard drops flat onto the stage

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome halftone book cutout standing upright on the cream stage with a hand-drawn burnt orange ladder of five rungs beside it

beats.change_only: all five orange rungs thicken into solid strokes

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the lowest rung of a hand-drawn burnt orange ladder picked out bright on the cream stage, the rungs above faded pale grey

beats.change_only: a small burnt orange arrow points at the bright lowest rung

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a row of small monochrome cutout figures across the cream stage, each with a small burnt orange tick above them

beats.change_only: every orange tick thickens at once

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the second rung of a hand-drawn burnt orange ladder picked out bright on the cream stage, the others pale grey

beats.change_only: a burnt orange marker circle draws around the bright rung
a small monochrome cutout figure leans in at the edge of the frame

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the third rung of a hand-drawn burnt orange ladder picked out bright on the cream stage, the others pale grey

beats.change_only: a burnt orange arrow curves down away from the bright rung
two small monochrome cutout figures appear leaning toward the rung

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the fourth rung of a hand-drawn burnt orange ladder picked out bright on the cream stage, the others pale grey

beats.change_only: a small monochrome book cutout slides in beneath the bright rung
the small book picks up a burnt orange edge stroke

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the top rung of a hand-drawn burnt orange ladder picked out bright on the cream stage, the rungs below faded pale grey

beats.change_only: a dense column of small blank monochrome cards rises beside the bright rung
a burnt orange bracket draws around the whole column of cards

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a complete five rung hand-drawn burnt orange ladder standing tall against bare cream paper on the cream stage

beats.change_only: the ladder tilts forward toward the viewer

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the oversized monochrome halftone hand drawing short burnt orange strokes onto a blank paper note on the cream stage

beats.change_only: the hand lifts clear of the note and the strokes stop

beats.scene: MEDIUM: two monochrome cutout figures facing each other on the cream stage, a single burnt orange arrow leaving one of them

beats.change_only: the arrow splits into three arrows fanning outward
two of the three arrows fade to pale grey

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome door cutout standing on the cream stage with a heavy burnt orange cross stroke drawn over it

beats.change_only: a burnt orange arc arrives from outside the frame toward the door

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a single small blank monochrome note on the cream stage edged burnt orange, a small orange arrow rising from it

beats.change_only: three short burnt orange strokes stack up on the note

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome hourglass on the cream stage half run through with burnt orange sand, bare cream paper around it

beats.change_only: the orange sand finishes running into the lower chamber
a burnt orange marker circle draws around the emptied hourglass

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: one monochrome cutout figure on the cream stage with three burnt orange strokes branching away toward three smaller figures
FULL-SPREAD: a wide branching burnt orange network of hand-drawn strokes spreading across the cream stage between small monochrome cutout figures
